entities.name: Query Mur ligase
observations: 504-residue cytosolic enzyme sequence contains Mur_ligase, Mur_ligase_M, and Mur_ligase_C domains.
Homology to reviewed MurD/MurE-family UDP-MurNAc peptide ligases is 43.4–44.4% identity over 92–94% query coverage.
Most strongly supported annotation is UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate–meso-2,6-diaminopimelate ligase, EC 6.3.2.13.
The sequence includes two ambiguous X residues, so sequence-derived physicochemical calculations were not performed.

entities.name: MurD/MurE DAP ligase reaction
observations: Reaction is linked to Rhea RHEA:23676 and EC 6.3.2.13.
Mg2+ is the reported cofactor for the homologous enzymes.

entities.name: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis
observations: The homologous ligases function in bacterial cell-wall peptidoglycan biosynthesis and are annotated to cytosol/cytoplasm.
